withdrawn.reason: Instrument invalid: the evidence packet handed to the treatment arm included fields that directly encode three of the four scored expected answers (evidence support -> confidence, forced analogue consensus -> analogue_outcome, next-hint phrasing -> next_action), so the reported 18.1% -> 65.3% uplift primarily measured transcription of the packet, not improved temporal reasoning. Withdrawn pending harness redesign and a fresh matched run.
